description: This file defines the PageAgentDispatcher class, which manages communication and interactions for a web page within a larger automation framework. It includes methods for performing actions, expectations, extracting data, and handling event callbacks related to conversational loops and tool calls.

classes.name: PageAgentDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class managing page-level agent interactions, including performing tasks, expectations, extraction, and event handling within a page context.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Executes a specified task within the page context and tracks usage.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Sets up an expectation within the page context and tracks usage.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts data based on query and schema, returning the result and usage.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Returns the current usage statistics for the page agent.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Performs cleanup and resource disposal for the dispatcher.
